designationHistory.name: Chautauqua Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Chautauqua Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7524; it is now Chautauqua National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Chautauqua National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7524—Establishing Chautauqua Migratory Waterfowl Refuge in the State of Illinois (Dec 23, 1936)

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Chautauqua National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1936 for the main purpose of providing sanctuary for the millions of birds that migrate along the Illinois River.
